evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.note: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff and git history were not consulted.

step_1_decode_scenario_name.claim: The '_120' suffix is Syndra's Splinters-of-Wrath stack count at its cap (the champion option is documented as 'splinters (0-120)'), not a cooldown or a fight length.
support: data/champions.json Syndra P 'Transcendent': 'Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath ... stacking up to 120 times.'
data/champions.json Syndra P: 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.'

data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json (Syndra): 'E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers.'

derivation: P 'Transcendent' is a passive AP buff, not a cast (data/champion-audit/batch-6.json: 'P = 120-splinter +15% total AP BUFF'), so it occupies no cast-order position.

Q 'Dark Sphere' Transcendent Bonus (data/champions.json): 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' 120 >= 40, so the second charge is live; the audit names it as the synthetic slot 'Q2' (data/champion-audit/batch-6.json module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R]; notable_atoms: 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)').
W 'Force of Will' recast throw is a damaging cast (70/100/130/160/190 + 65% AP, plus the 60-splinter true-damage bonus, which 120 satisfies).
E 'Scatter the Weak' is a damaging cast (60/95/130/165/200 + 60% AP).
R 'Unleashed Power' is a damaging cast: 'Magic Damage per Sphere' 80/120/160 (+20% AP), min 240/360/480 (+60% AP), max 560/840/1120 (+140% AP).
Therefore a one-rotation fight for Syndra at 120 splinters contains exactly five ability casts, i.e. cast_order has indices 0..4 and index 4 must exist.

step_3_R_appears_exactly_once.rule: docs/math-foundations.md Section 5 formula-audit table: 'R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)' and, on the rotation row, 'R single-cast'.
step_3_R_appears_exactly_once.consequence: Because indices 0..3 are reported unchanged and the new index 4 is 'R', the pre-change list of four entries contained no R at all - a two-R list would violate the documented single-cast constraint. So the old rotation omitted Syndra's ultimate entirely, and the change restores the one R the model requires. It also rules out the competing hypotheses that would put something else at index 4: if the old four entries had been a permutation containing R (e.g. E,Q,W,R), the missing fifth slot would be Q2, and index 4 would read 'Q2', not 'R'.

reasons: Default ordering: data/worklists/f2-task.md records the engine's fallback as 'DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R)' - R terminal.

Setup -> consume mechanic (the exact criterion f2-task.md names for ordering): R 'conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones' (data/champions.json Syndra R). Live spheres come from Q/Q2 ('The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds'), so R must follow the sphere-placing casts to reach its sourced sphere count (the module's r_spheres option). Casting R first would strand it at its 3-sphere minimum.

Finisher semantics: R's 100-splinter Transcendent Bonus is an execute below 15% max health - a closing cast, not an opening buff. The 'buff first' exception in f2-task.md (Aatrox R, Vladimir R, cast_order 'R,Q,W,E' in data/champion-audit/batch-p1-3.json) does not apply: Syndra's R grants no self-buff.
Cooldowns do not gate the position: in a single rotation each slot fires once, and R's 120/100/80 s cooldown (data/champions.json) only limits recasts.

independent_computation.conclusion: The correct cast_order for Syndra at 120 splinters is the five casts Q, Q2, W, E, R with R terminal; index 4 = 'R'. The old value (index 4 absent, i.e. a four-cast rotation with no ultimate) understates the rotation by one modeled damaging slot.

residual_assumption: This holds unless the scenario's 'custom order' input deliberately excluded R (a user-authored four-cast order). The evidence tree contains no scenario definitions, so that input could not be read; it is judged unlikely because a rotation that never casts the ultimate contradicts the engine's own documented constraint that R casts exactly once per fight, and because the four unchanged leading entries plus a terminal R reconstruct exactly the default Q,W,E,R order with the 40-splinter Q2 charge inserted.
